writeMethod: Direct single-parent master commits with force=false; no PR, staging branch or new workflow. Reconciled concurrent Guild, Vesperfall and Prism changes and preserved sibling source.
changedScope: Sixteen Neighborhood source/test/documentation paths in the main implementation, then three scoped files for the browser range correction. All changes remain within svgn-planet. Existing publication and acceptance workflows are unchanged.

diagnosis.interactionText: The old runtime hid desktop toast text in XR but did not render equivalent interaction captions during normal play.
diagnosis.liveMap: The previous compact map depended on a raised, unused free hand. No independent persistent floor map existed.
diagnosis.floorReference: An estimated floor could remain in use after a late valid local-floor reference arrived, placing seated users' UI below the actual floor.
diagnosis.menuRange: An actual Chromium input test reproduced .72 being sanitized to .70 by step=.05. The .01 step preserves the saved .72 and changes it to .73 on increment.

implementation.map: Independent scene-space floor map is on by default, updates at up to 5 Hz during normal play, and uses the actual current city or full-resolution Lantern Ward map and selected objective. It has no hand or head-angle visibility gate.
implementation.captions: One floor plate displays actual interaction messages, opaque for 1600 ms and fading during the final 400 ms, fully absent at 2000 ms. Unchanged source timers cannot repeatedly resurrect an expired notice.
implementation.messageHistory: The last twelve notices remain available through Read recent interaction text in each district menu, with complete text divided into small native pages. The history is in-memory for the current document, not a new gameplay save.
implementation.placement: Floor map and caption geometry use a fixed floor anchor, not a headset child or an eye-facing billboard. Deliberate recentering moves them. A late measured floor adjusts height without copying subsequent head translation.
implementation.diorama: Default box height is tripled from .68 m to 2.04 m at the original scale. Independent box-height multiplier supports 1-6. Width/depth and canonical player/world transforms do not change merely because box height changes.
implementation.sizeControls: Resize menus / diorama / floor map exposes menu size .35-1.6, overall diorama size 25-300 percent, independent vertical box height and floor-map size .6-2. Existing controller/pinch controls operate them.
implementation.preferences: New view size/placement uses svgn.neighborhood-xr-presentation.v1. Existing console v1 values remain intact with optional floorMap and mapSize fields. Unknown future or invalid stored preferences are not overwritten during loading.
implementation.preserved: Main city/Lantern Ward integration, eight native modes, full-depth portal clipping, hero centering, opening rule, hidden normal-play menus, wrist option, physical left/right trigger choices, original movement, save identities and independent reward ledgers.
implementation.notIncluded: No private SaaS hub, A-Frame migration, cross-site portal, geometry expansion or unfinished historical-feature recovery.

publication.independentComparison: Downloaded the public result and recomputed all 326 expected hashes against the exact downloaded published-source archive. Zero differences. Includes JavaScript MIME and actual revisioned entry/module requests, not just a build status.

sourceVerification.DOMScope: Actual range behavior, event listeners, synchronized size controls, floor-map preference and message-history navigation, with presentation hooks. Not WebGL or headset approval.
sourceVerification.localWebGL: Could not acquire WebGL2. No local full-game rendered acceptance is claimed.

remainingRenderedEvidence.atRecording: First-person VR, third-person VR and diorama-third AR source journeys are running; public console and native navigation journeys are running. Pending jobs are not accepted.
remainingRenderedEvidence.addedCoverage: All eight existing console modes retain earlier assertions and add actual resize inputs, persistent map refresh with lowered hands, input-triggered mount/dismount caption capture, fade expiry, and selected-mission map update. No actor/message/mission state is assigned to manufacture success.

initialCheckpoint.scope: 437-test initial implementation before the .01 menu-range correction. Earlier queued, cancelled or failed browser results do not establish acceptance of the corrected revision.

recovery: Resume from current master, AGENTS.md and FLOOR-FEEDBACK.md. Inspect final actual source/public browser artifacts, preserve failures, and do not equate model or deployment success with physical visibility. This receipt is outside the game closure and changes no published game file.
